name: Mailchimp
tagline: Email marketing platform with campaign builder, automation, and audience management

pricing.notes: Based on 500 contacts; price scales with audience size

verdictSummary: Sending email is solved by providers like Resend or AWS SES. A template builder with drag-and-drop blocks is buildable with a block-based editor. Audience management is a CRUD contacts database. The core value — design email, manage list, hit send — is all DIY-friendly.
coreLoopDIY: Email campaign builder + contact list management + send via Resend/SES
requirements: Rich text or block-based template editor
moatNotes: Email deliverability at scale is surprisingly hard — inbox placement, bounce handling, and domain reputation are real moats
whyPeopleStillPay: Deliverability guarantees and the marketing automation workflows that connect email to their CRM, ecommerce, and analytics

priorArt.name: Sendy
priorArt.desc: Self-hosted email newsletter app using SES

notes: Sendy is the classic DIY approach. For a one-shot, use Resend for email delivery and build the template editor yourself.
